; PROBE (temporary): can a FoldoutItem iconSource point at our own SVG file?
;
; ArkControls.Icon does NOT hand the source straight to an Image — it runs it through
; ArkImageDataProvider.resolveImageInfo(source, blackAndWhite, borderColor, fill), which is
; built for "qrc:/ark/icons/<name>" tokens. So the question is whether it passes an external
; path through. Log-only: tests the resolver on three URL forms, and separately loads the SVG
; in a plain Image to confirm the Qt SVG plugin renders it in-process (libqsvg.so is present).
;
; Failure mode if the resolver rejects it: Icon just sets hasError and becomes invisible —
; the menu item keeps its label, so nothing breaks either way.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DeviceSceneView.qml
	TRAVERSE ?#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			Item {
				id: iconProbe
				visible: false

				readonly property string svgFile: "/home/root/xovi/exthome/qt-resource-rebuilder/pinnedSleepScreen.svg"

				Repeater {
					id: iconForms
					model: []
					delegate: Item {
						id: formDel
						required property string modelData
						Image {
							source: formDel.modelData
							asynchronous: true
							sourceSize: Qt.size(40, 40)
							onStatusChanged: {
								if (status === Image.Loading) return;
								console.log("ICONPROBE image form=" + formDel.modelData
									+ " status=" + (status === Image.Ready ? "READY" : "ERROR")
									+ " " + implicitWidth + "x" + implicitHeight);
							}
						}
					}
				}

				Component.onCompleted: {
					var forms = [
						"file://" + iconProbe.svgFile,
						iconProbe.svgFile,
						"file://" + iconProbe.svgFile + "?x=1"
					];
					iconForms.model = forms;

					console.log("ICONPROBE resolver typeof=" + (typeof ArkImageDataProvider));
					if (typeof ArkImageDataProvider !== "undefined") {
						for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i++) {
							try {
								var info = ArkImageDataProvider.resolveImageInfo(
									forms[i], false, "#000000", "#000000");
								console.log("ICONPROBE resolve form=" + forms[i]
									+ " -> source=" + info.source
									+ " size=" + info.size.width + "x" + info.size.height);
							} catch (e) {
								console.log("ICONPROBE resolve form=" + forms[i] + " threw " + e);
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
